# HighDimProb Code Knowledge Graph

This directory contains a pre-built code knowledge graph for the HighDimProb
Lean 4 project, generated by
[codebase-memory-mcp](https://github.com/DeusData/codebase-memory-mcp).

## Contents

- **HighDimProb.db** - SQLite knowledge graph database.
- **metadata.json** - Graph statistics and structure summary.
- **graphviz/** - Rendered Graphviz views generated from `HighDimProb.db`.

The graph is also committed in the team-shared compressed format at
`.codebase-memory/graph.db.zst`.

## Usage

The database can be queried using the codebase-memory-mcp tool:

```bash
codebase-memory-mcp cli search_graph '{"project":"...","name_pattern":".*Pattern.*"}'
codebase-memory-mcp cli trace_path '{"function_name":"FuncName","direction":"both"}'
codebase-memory-mcp cli query_graph '{"query":"MATCH (f:Function) RETURN f.name LIMIT 10"}'
```

Or via the MCP server tools integrated with Claude Code, Codex, and other
agents.

## Graph Schema

The exact counts are recorded in `metadata.json`. The expected graph contains
these core node labels:

| Label    | Description                        |
|----------|------------------------------------|
| Section  | Lean sections/namespaces           |
| Function | Lean definitions/theorems/lemmas   |
| File     | Source files (.lean, .md, .yml)    |
| Module   | Lean modules                       |
| Variable | Lean variables/constants           |
| Folder   | Directory structure                |
| Project  | Root project node                  |

And these primary edge types:

| Type                | Description               |
|---------------------|---------------------------|
| DEFINES             | Definition relationships  |
| CALLS               | Function call edges       |
| USAGE               | Symbol usage references   |
| CONTAINS_FILE       | Directory containment     |
| IMPORTS             | Module import edges       |
| CONTAINS_FOLDER     | Folder hierarchy          |
| SEMANTICALLY_RELATED | Semantic similarity edges |

## Regeneration

The GitHub Actions workflow `.github/workflows/codebase-memory.yml` refreshes
the graph automatically on pushes to `main` that touch Lean source, repository
docs, or workflow files. It commits refreshed graph artifacts back to the branch
and also uploads them as a workflow artifact.

The workflow `.github/workflows/codebase-memory-graphviz.yml` runs whenever
`HighDimProb.db` changes. It exports DOT files and renders SVG views under
`external/codebase-memory/graphviz/`.

To regenerate locally:

```bash
python .github/scripts/codebase_memory_update.py --repo . --cache-dir .codebase-memory/cache --mode full
python .github/scripts/codebase_memory_graphviz.py --render
```

If Graphviz is not installed locally, omit `--render`; the script will still
write the DOT files. The GitHub Action installs Graphviz before rendering SVGs.
